title: literature.brief_ready (v1)
description: DeepResearchAgent has finished the two-pass literature search and frozen a LiteratureBrief + FieldTrajectoryBrief into the Research Store. ResearchOrchestrator uses this to transition DeepResearching -> ReinterpretingSpec (state machine V1.10 §1). Payload is intentionally minimal: the briefs themselves (see agents/deep_research_agent/data-contracts/{literature_brief,field_trajectory_brief}.schema.yaml) are read from the Research Store by ref.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

field_trajectory_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen FieldTrajectoryBrief object.
